errors.evidence: The description simplifies the labels on the right-hand pie chart. The original labels are '‘的’字只现不隐' ('de' character only appears, not hidden) and '‘的’字只隐不现' ('de' character only hidden, not appearing). The simplified labels '‘的’字显现' (appears) and '‘的’字不显现' (doesn't appear) lose the specific linguistic nuance of exclusivity ('只...不...').
The description incorrectly states that there is no legend. The image clearly shows a legend at the bottom with numbered squares corresponding to the slice colors (1=orange, 2=blue, 3=green).
The description omits the raw case counts (791例 and 279例) that are explicitly provided on the slices of the left pie chart, alongside the percentages.
